changelog:
- Added multi-game support: manage mods for any installed game, with automatic detection of installed Steam games to import.
- Added an in-app mod marketplace with GameBanana search/browse and pum:// one-click install support.
- Added a backup manager to create, restore, import and export mod-state backups.
- Added a conflict detector that flags mods sharing the same .pak file name before they collide in-game.
- Profile import now detects missing mods and offers to auto-download them.
- Added a mod 'parts' configuration window for multi-file mods.
- Added keyboard shortcuts.
- Added a virtualized mod list with grid/list view toggle for large mod collections.
- Rebuilt the auto-updater with an on/off toggle and configurable check frequency.
- Massively expanded translations across all supported languages.
- Fixed popup windows not showing the app icon on Windows.
